spans.s:
mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं)
1 Opulent, wealthy, rich.
2 Abounding in, productive.
3 Having, being possessed of.
E.
आङ्, ध्ये to consider, to meditate, क irregular aff.

n. (-णं)
Enriching, or the means of enriching, wealth, prosperity.
E.
आढ्य and ख्युन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Formerly opulent.
E.
आध्य and चरट् aff.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Becoming rich or eminent.
E.
आढ्य and भी to be, खिष्णुच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Becoming rich or eminent.
E.
आढ्य and भू to be, with खुकञ् aff.
